title: The Fifth Asking

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A question asked five times is still a question, and a row with no name is a place nobody stands in. What the boards keep is not an answer; what the wool covers gathers no figure.
epigraph.attribution: Two sayings of the Clay Yard, told in the last working tend of Smoke

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and forty-six to two hundred and forty-eight days, six months and sixty-six days to six months and sixty-eight days, carried everywhere and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing --- the file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing; the body inventoried as a wound is inventoried, crust, gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop in the order they arrive; five askings over the boards opened as a wound is opened and found to have no witness at the bottom, a seed and not a hearing; a count kept in wood held on its own tray and not read; the dressed grain's read figure held apart from the figure paid; the sweet edge of glaze arriving on the wind that brought it and going out on it, a direction and not a second edge paid --- without a present-tense Chicago break or a tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no hearing beyond six, no seventh of the full note, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, no sixth asking and no witness for the row question, no fifth telling of the burned slate, no third telling of the counting room shut in the war, no fourth likeness of the pot saying, no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, no tenth record-first hand-shape, no eighth green or eighth shape, no name spoken over either, no sale, no calling of the loan, no payer named for the carried fire's fifth or for any warmth under this roof, no private record opened, read or copied, no figure given for the dressed grain or for the hand that did not come back, no lesson made of the one opening before Smoke 1, which is behind the household and not looked at again, and no ending.

scenes.title: The Day Not Yet Earned
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, first dated heading and the chapter's only drop cap (`\dropcap` on the opening words): Day 246, Smoke 7, Seventhday, small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth and the kiln mouth. Open in the small hours with the hand laid down against the fold on the sixty-sixth answer and the file open on the towel; set that coordination down like a tool, never recalled as a sign, growth, reaching, gift or power. Count carried at 245 exact, six months and sixty-five days, told by nobody, coming into **246**, six months and sixty-six days (T071/T072); first smell hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the unswept corner called the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, not a bell. No market, no Cross and no bell on a Seventhday; Smoke 10 (Day 249), the first Account-day and market of the second firing, stands three mornings ahead and unbrought. Three counts in three places --- the carried fire's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand under the floor, its payer unnamed two hundred and forty-six days (T088), the river's note of water over water through the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot --- none rising into another, for agreeing them would want a payer and none stands to any (T061/T082). Body inventory: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform; the surgeon takes the inventory and enters it nowhere (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it*, counts under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale off the coals; the burn shaped like a little door closes on nothing. The widow's mark hangs where it hangs, untouched at a shelf, a well, a rack and a basket, for the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour; the one opening before Smoke 1 lies behind the household, not looked at again as sign, lesson, mending or payment (T058/T079). The dressed grain is turned under wool for damp, spread thin, gathered back by the handful, fold set flat; changed state, gained no figure, entered on no slate, laid across none of the absences (T077). Cost-questions go to the pot and the weather; a man's number comes up out of a fist toward the well, is looked at and goes back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere and is not a missing figure (T015/T041/T047 held). Garl is kept in objects and not in a story: salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw unswept, proverb gone to a pot with no crack, tile debt circling without a name, name unspoken two hundred and forty-six days, no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). First hand question: hand up an inch toward the low note through the finger's-width door, down at once on the river's note. Answer **sixty-seven** filed on the sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: Four Nails and a Knot
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 246, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the boards before it, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the flagstones and shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge, the finger's-width-open back room rendered only as a direction and a sound, the clay road at the going of the light, the bed. Afternoon thins without ending; heat settles behind the pot, under the shelf's low angle, into the fold; crust, gap, frozen thread, cold at cheek--temple--wrist, afterdrop waiting (T061/T082). Garl in objects, name unspoken two hundred and forty-six days, no collector on the clay road (T009/T013/T092). Sella at the loaf shelf with her back to the basket: lips along the two-gapped row with no figure; one glance at the clay jar cold under its glaze and her hand shut half over nothing; finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal tally stays unread and uncounted; pot rim set out and handle turned two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed (T100). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed, says *Yes, house* to the wood and *Six counted. The next I don't count* in the tone of a man stating the weather, sets the small knife at the very edge of its sill with six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it with no name on the man and no figure on the debt. The ear-sentence about an ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that holds it comes to his teeth and goes all the way to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name --- a remembered stopping and not a new one --- nine stoppings stand with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath is drawn at the top of the reach and not spent, the loan uncalled, no collector came on Smoke 7, chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, the pale clip-ring at the left wrist holding what light there is, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its unmarked loft pot, which is not forgiving (T036/T076, T006). His stroke goes over the shallow bright patch without the half-check and over the road a house sends a man down when it wants a collector, without once turning along it. At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and under the nails, white in the creases where a fist had opened, not bone-coloured slip; dusty and clean forearms on one tray; asks neither which slate broke nor whether it was a birth-slate; speaks to the wheel before anyone (*It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady*) and tells a pot *You'll do* with no welcome and no unkindness. He knows the full note that pot will give three turns ahead, with air under it and a want in it, and withholds the knowing on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them, advanced and not paid (T061/T082). The burned-slate word stands at four from Slate Row and the two tellings of the counting room shut in the war stand at two and do not become three; no name has been given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188; three shapings of the pot saying stay three and no fourth likeness is made a cause, for a likeness made a cause wants a payer and none stands to any (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095, T064 held). When Sella's sentence goes low and unfinished his bent finger goes into the cold iron of the damper ahead of it, takes the cold out, holds while the little silence runs, moves a hair's breadth and is left standing --- a remembered repetition paired with no other fraction, one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, joined to no kiln. Men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey and got no name; the room keeps its finger's width of open and its sound of low voices. *He's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn. Second hand question: hand up an inch, held for the small intake only, down before the letting-go. Answer **sixty-eight** filed with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What the Sleeve Keeps
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated heading: Day 247, Smoke 8, Eighthday, small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the drying racks, the Clay Yard and the yard well. New day, new date, no recap: **247** exact, six months and sixty-seven days, nobody told (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and forty-seven days (T088); widow's mark touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no other hour, not at a shelf, a well, a rack or a basket on this morning (T058/T079); first smell hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the thaw; first sound the kiln in fours with its gap, no bell, no market and no Cross, for Smoke 10 (Day 249) stands two mornings ahead and is unbrought. The dressed grain is turned under wool for damp, spread thin, gathered back by the handful, fold set flat; changed state, gained no figure, entered on no slate, laid across no absence (T077). A neighbour at the threshold with a pot asks what the keeping will take now the grain is under wool and Sella sends the question to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, refused or entered; a man come down the clay road with dried pale mud-scurf on his coat skirt brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere and is not a missing figure (T015/T041/T047 held). Sella lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, glances at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, sets the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T100). The yard goes around the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone ring, the bare dark trough, the field's empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back, each with a look and a wide step and no number (T098 carried, T060/T086). **Ilva sighting, T080 held at nine and not advanced to a tenth:** at the yard well a woman of the firing work draws water with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb. Asked how the firings stand she does not take the strip from her sleeve this time; her hand stays where it is and she answers the question put and not the one behind it: *It's kept where it's kept. Ask the pot what it cost.* She goes on with her water, and nobody turns to look at her twice. The boy files no tenth hand-shape; the ninth stays on its place of its own beside the eighth with a finger between every pair, and the notched birch stays in her sleeve, not read, not asked about, not joined to the reed-cutter's cord, the knots, the pages, the tins, the missing hand, the pale line or any other private keeping (T080 held, not paid). She is not Marra, not Hessa Rale, not the soft-cuffed clerk and not an officer. Third hand question: hand up an inch, kept to the river's own low interval with no count in the house to hold it against, then down on the next note. Answer **sixty-nine** filed with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Fifth Asking
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 247, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the boards fronting it, the hearth, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light, the terrace and the bed. **The chapter's one meaningful change** (T101 advanced, not paid): in the afternoon a voice with no owner, no room, no hand at the kiln and no cause asks over the boards a **fifth** time, *Which row did the pot go quiet on?* The weather answers first --- a wrong wind off High Kiln carries the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touches the fold and goes out on the wind that brought it --- and the price of barley answers after it; the voice goes off up the terrace while the row stands where it stood and nobody leans in to take the answer down. The boy opens the asking as a surgeon opens a wound and finds no witness at the bottom. Five askings stand on a seventh place of its own with a finger between each pair: still not one witness, not a fourth shaping of the pot saying, not a hearing, not a seventh of the full note, not a fifth telling of the burned slate, not a third telling of the counting room, not a cause, not a name and not a row named. Three shapings of the pot saying stay three; the sweet edge is a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid; no fourth likeness is made a cause, no pot is lost and no name is given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, nor is the green at a silent woman's mouth joined to the wind (T064 held, T101 advanced and unpaid). The rest of the tend holds its old grammar: afternoon thins into the fold; crust, gap, frozen thread, cold at cheek--temple--wrist, afterdrop waiting; Garl in objects, name unspoken two hundred and forty-seven days, no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 7 or 8 (T009/T013/T092); Sella gives the fire its instruction before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it*, counts toward no opening, leaves the mark where it hangs at a shelf, an afternoon and a dusk, lips the two-gapped row without a figure, glances at the clay jar, keeps her finger on top of the front edge so the charcoal stays unread and sets the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079, T100); at the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it is instructed, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, sets the knife at the very edge of its sill with six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, brings the ear-sentence all the way to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name as a remembered stopping --- nine stoppings, no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, chest tight since the dark, Ash in the knuckles, pale clip-ring at the wrist, warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006); at the wheel-shed Jorra parts dust from slip, tells a pot *You'll do*, withholds the note known three turns ahead, keeps the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, lets his bent finger lead at the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition, gives the men unnamed in the back room no name and keeps *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Fourth hand question: hand up an inch, through the small intake, the hold and the letting-go of one of Sella's counted breaths from the room that does not touch his, kept through the little silence after her count, down on the river's next low note --- two rhythms crossing in the inch and nowhere else, remembered and not a change made again. Answer **seventy** filed with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Last Working Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated heading: Day 248, Smoke 9, Ninthday, small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the drying racks, the Clay Yard, the boards and the terrace. New day, new date, no recap: **248** exact, six months and sixty-eight days, nobody told (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and forty-eight days (T088); widow's mark touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk (T058/T079); first smell hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the thaw; first sound the kiln in fours with its gap, no bell, no market and no Cross; Smoke 10 (Day 249), the first Account-day and market of the second firing, stands one morning ahead and is not brought early. The dressed grain is turned under wool for damp, spread thin to finish, gathered back by the handful and the fold set flat; changed state, gained no figure, counted in glances, handfuls and by an arm that knows weight and not cost, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077). A neighbour's cost-question goes to the pot and the weather; a man come down the clay road with a number in his fist brings it up toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere (T015/T041/T047 held). The figure read over the covered grain on Grain 30 is still not the figure paid and the true subtraction stays locked in Berr Clay's box, going up and down the clay road and answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188. Sella lips along the two-gapped row, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, sets the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T100); the yard goes around the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space, the pan's gone ring, the field's empty place and the returning-line place with a look and a wide step and no number (T098 carried, T009/T013/T092). Garl is kept in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and forty-eight days, no collector on the clay road (T009/T013/T092). Fifth hand question: hand up an inch toward the low note through the finger's-width door and kept through the little silence after Sella's count has ended in the room that does not touch his, without crossing two rhythms, then down on the river's next low note. Answer **seventy-one** --- one rhythm held across the silence and not two crossed --- filed with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Sixth Place
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 248, Smoke 9, Ninthday, afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth and kiln mouth, the salt coat and hollow wheel-seat, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light, the bed under the roof. Smoke goes out without a boundary drawn in the narration; neither of the district's two names for the months is corrected; Smoke 10 (Day 249), the first Account-day and market of the second firing, stands beyond the close and is not brought into a day that has not earned it. Afternoon thins; heat into the fold; one stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting. Garl in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and forty-eight days, no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 7, 8 or 9, his keeping maintenance and not a story (T009/T013/T092). Sella gives the fire its instruction before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say *I*, counts under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale; the widow's mark is as it was after the one opening before Smoke 1, touched at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk on any of these three days, because the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour; the opening is behind the household, no lesson made, no payer named (T058/T079, T100). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it is instructed, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, sets the knife where six can be checked and the seventh cannot, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name, a remembered stopping and not a new one; nine stoppings, no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, chest tight since the dark, Ash in the knuckles, pale clip-ring at the wrist, warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine dust past the bent finger, parts dust from slip, tells a pot *You'll do*, withholds the note known three turns ahead, keeps the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, holds his bent finger in the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition paired with no other fraction, gives the men unnamed no name, keeps *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). The boy turns out the file as instruments on a towel and finds it exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place; three near-full answers advanced and unpaid; three pot sayings; the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings; the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, with Grain's third subtraction locked in Berr Clay's box; nine stoppings with no tenth; the three held changes --- the Day 161 fraction, the Day 166 held beat, the Tallow 22 half-check --- plus the loft scrape, the pale line and the held inch on six places; the **ninth** record-first hand-shape on a place of its own with a finger between it and the eighth and between it and every other private keeping (T080 held, not paid); the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth and no name; the dressed grain covered and unfigured; the pan's gone ring on its own tray; the returning-line place gone around with a look and no number; and the ownerless question on its seventh place with **five askings** and no witness standing (T101 advanced, not paid). He draws no finger between the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the field's empty place and the returning-line place, and no fourth likeness is made a cause (T060/T086, T098). Sixth hand question: hand up an inch toward the low note through the finger's-width door, through the small intake, the hold and the letting-go of one of Sella's counted breaths in the room that does not touch his, kept through the little silence after her count, down on the river's next low note --- two rhythms crossing in the inch and nowhere else, across a wall that does not touch, remembered and not a change made again; not a longer reach, miss entered, hearing, seventh, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule. Answer **seventy-two** filed with no payer named (T061/T082). Six months and sixty-eight days told by nobody; the fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and forty-eight days, its payer without a name; the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven. The hand lays itself down against the fold like a tool put away. The count goes forward into Smoke 10, a day that has not yet earned its heading.
